title: Label Coverage Bounds Pooled Macro F1 in Closed-Set Benchmarks: Reproducibility Artifact
description: Code, fold-count audits, confusion matrices and manuscript sources for a reporting check on vocabulary-constrained pooled scoring. Includes five-seed NSL-KDD pipeline comparisons under positive-test-support and inferred-union scoring, plus the full UNSW pair grid. This metadata file does not establish a deposited record or DOI.
